assumptions: Every tracked vehicle is treated as approaching a stop sign; stop-sign presence is not checked.
The limit line is assumed marked and corresponds to line packing_entry with the inspection zone as the waiting area just before it.
The alternative stopping positions when there is no marked limit line (before the crosswalk, entrance to intersecting roadway) are out of scope and not checked.
Forward crossing over the stop line is taken as to_left from the camera geometry where cars travel bottom-right to top-left.
A stop is taken as continuously stopped for at least 1000 ms; the statute states no duration.
Position is tested at bottom_center because zones and lines are drawn on the road surface for vehicle ground contact.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line must have first stopped in the waiting zone before crossing.

text:
The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection.

If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
